notes: Added missing core logic, API enforcement, and test coverage stories to meet minimum and complete feature breakdown.

change_log.value: Unit and integration tests for enforcement

GPTR-F-001-S156.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S156.description: Implement the core enforcement engine that evaluates incoming GPTReader queries against the allowlist schema, rejecting disallowed collections, fields, operators, or limit violations and returning structured error responses.

GPTR-F-001-S157.title: API Boundary Enforcement Integration
GPTR-F-001-S157.description: Integrate allowlist enforcement into the Azure Function entrypoint for GPTReader so that all incoming requests are validated and enforced before any database access occurs, ensuring zero bypass paths.

GPTR-F-001-S158.title: Allowlist Enforcement Unit and Integration Tests
GPTR-F-001-S158.description: Develop comprehensive unit and integration tests validating allowlist enforcement, including rejection of invalid queries, acceptance of valid queries, edge cases (field overreach, operator misuse), and regression coverage aligned to SIT scenarios.
